items.text: While you record, a line moves with your voice and words say what the microphone hears.
items.alt: A thin line that rises and falls as if someone speaks, then rests; under it the words Recording. I can hear you.

items.text: A recording ends when you tap Finish, not when you pause to think.
items.alt: The line goes flat for a long pause while the Finish button stays as it is, then moves again

items.text: Your words appear as text you can correct before anything is sent.
items.alt: A sentence in a field; one word is struck out and replaced, and then the Send button lights
